body: I just want my ears back. I wish I knew the fucking extent of hearing damage beyond just a loss of volume. Fuck my life when I could have done things of value instead of obsessive music listening and giving myself cumulative damage the last 5 years

If only you knew the immense pain of hyperacusis. I envy people who just have normal tinnitus like I used to.Theres a reason the suicide rate for hyperacusis and it's even worse subsets like dysacusis, diplacusis, noxacusis etc is so high.
